description: Upload a new file to a course's Files area from base64-encoded content, and return the created file object (id, display_name, size, content_type, download url). Each call performs a new upload; check list_files first if you want to avoid creating a duplicate, and use delete_file to remove a file afterward. Canvas handles the upload as a multi-step hand-off to its storage backend (S3 or local Canvas storage), transparent to the caller. `parent_folder_path` places the file in that folder, creating any missing folder segment along the way; see list_folders for what already exists. Requires permission to manage files in the course.

parent_folder_path.description: Destination folder path within the course, e.g. "subfolder/nested"

name: upload_file
title: Upload File
